title: 真空預壓軟土改良
summary: 本課聚焦連結負孔壓傳遞、排水能力與卸載回彈判斷真空壓密。十個單元依序辨識作用機制、量化假設、驗證程序與故障徵兆，讓學徒追蹤從原始資料到工程判斷的每一環。每個算例都帶單位與限制，不把局部成功或單一比值當成完整系統合格。交接須保留基準、異常與權責工程師核准的條件。
summaryEn: This course focuses on relate suction transfer, drainage capacity and unloading rebound to vacuum consolidation. Ten units connect mechanisms, numerical assumptions, verification procedures and failure symptoms so apprentices can trace each inference from evidence to judgment. Every example includes units and limitations; one successful observation or ratio does not establish system acceptance. Handover retains datums, anomalies and conditions approved by the responsible engineer.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「有效應力增量」與「深度負壓傳遞」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Effective stress increment" and "Suction transfer with depth": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 有效應力增量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Effective stress increment: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「有效應力增量」如何影響真空預壓軟土改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Effective stress increment” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Vacuum consolidation of soft soil”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 真空預壓透過降低孔隙水壓增加有效應力，不需要把相同荷載全由堆載重量提供。必須先說清楚所選土點的總應力是否保持不變，並區分抽氣系統壓力與土中孔壓。教學假設總應力固定、孔壓變化Δu=−60kPa，Δσ′=−Δu=60kPa；此式不代表任何深度都收到相同負壓。若把泵浦端負壓直接當深層孔壓，會高估深層改良；表面沉陷可能來自上層，尚未壓密的深層土在完工載重後仍會持續沉陷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「有效應力增量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Vacuum preloading increases effective stress by reducing pore pressure rather than supplying all loading through fill weight. Specify whether total stress stays fixed at the selected soil point and distinguish pump pressure from soil pore pressure. At fixed total stress and pore-pressure change Δu=−60kPa, Δσ′=−Δu=60kPa. The relation does not imply equal suction at every depth. Substituting pump suction for deep pore pressure overstates treatment at depth. Surface settlement may occur mainly in upper layers while untreated deeper soil continues settling under the completed structure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Effective stress increment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：教學假設總應力固定、孔壓變化Δu=−60kPa，Δσ′=−Δu=60kPa；此式不代表任何深度都收到相同負壓。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At fixed total stress and pore-pressure change Δu=−60kPa, Δσ′=−Δu=60kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要有效應力增量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for effective stress increment removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「有效應力增量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Effective stress increment”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 有效應力增量
knowledge.text: 真空預壓透過降低孔隙水壓增加有效應力，不需要把相同荷載全由堆載重量提供。必須先說清楚所選土點的總應力是否保持不變，並區分抽氣系統壓力與土中孔壓。
knowledge.textEn: Vacuum preloading increases effective stress by reducing pore pressure rather than supplying all loading through fill weight. Specify whether total stress stays fixed at the selected soil point and distinguish pump pressure from soil pore pressure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要有效應力增量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for effective stress increment removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「真空預壓軟土改良」的「有效應力增量：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出地層、地下水、開挖邊界與支撐的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「地下水與沉陷觀測室」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與地質假設、監測位置、時間順序及基準點版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Effective stress increment: mechanism and system paths” in “Vacuum consolidation of soft soil”. Draw the ground, groundwater, excavation boundary and support interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Groundwater and settlement observatory” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ground assumptions, monitoring locations, time order and benchmark version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「有效應力增量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Effective stress increment" is correct?
options: 只要有效應力增量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
真空預壓透過降低孔隙水壓增加有效應力，不需要把相同荷載全由堆載重量提供。
只要深度負壓傳遞符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for effective stress increment removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Vacuum preloading increases effective stress by reducing pore pressure rather than supplying all loading through fill weight.
A nominal result for suction transfer with depth removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 真空預壓透過降低孔隙水壓增加有效應力，不需要把相同荷載全由堆載重量提供。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Vacuum preloading increases effective stress by reducing pore pressure rather than supplying all loading through fill weight. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 有效應力增量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Effective stress increment: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「有效應力增量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Effective stress increment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：教學假設總應力固定、孔壓變化Δu=−60kPa，Δσ′=−Δu=60kPa；此式不代表任何深度都收到相同負壓。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At fixed total stress and pore-pressure change Δu=−60kPa, Δσ′=−Δu=60kPa. The relation does not imply equal suction at every depth. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測土中孔壓、地表荷載及沉陷，將每個測點換到相同高程基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize soil pressure, surface loading and settlement on a common elevation datum.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：教學假設總應力固定、孔壓變化Δu=−60kPa，Δσ′=−Δu=60kPa；此式不代表任何深度都收到相同負壓。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At fixed total stress and pore-pressure change Δu=−60kPa, Δσ′=−Δu=60kPa. The relation does not imply equal suction at every depth.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「有效應力增量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Effective stress increment", which statement holds?
options: 只要透水夾層補注符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要堆載真空疊加符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：教學假設總應力固定、孔壓變化Δu=−60kPa，Δσ′=−Δu=60kPa；此式不代表任何深度都收到相同負壓。
optionsEn: A nominal result for recharge through permeable lenses removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for surcharge and vacuum combination removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At fixed total stress and pore-pressure change Δu=−60kPa, Δσ′=−Δu=60kPa.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：教學假設總應力固定、孔壓變化Δu=−60kPa，Δσ′=−Δu=60kPa；此式不代表任何深度都收到相同負壓。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At fixed total stress and pore-pressure change Δu=−60kPa, Δσ′=−Δu=60kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 有效應力增量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Effective stress increment: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「有效應力增量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Effective stress increment” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測土中孔壓、地表荷載及沉陷，將每個測點換到相同高程基準。確認負孔壓感測能力與飽和狀態，讓有效應力推論有可追溯的原始資料。同時排除以下干擾原因：若把泵浦端負壓直接當深層孔壓，會高估深層改良；表面沉陷可能來自上層，尚未壓密的深層土在完工載重後仍會持續沉陷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize soil pressure, surface loading and settlement on a common elevation datum. Check sensor saturation and negative-pressure capability so the effective-stress inference rests on traceable observations. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Substituting pump suction for deep pore pressure overstates treatment at depth. Surface settlement may occur mainly in upper layers while untreated deeper soil continues settling under the completed structure. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接有效應力增量時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。同步量測土中孔壓、地表荷載及沉陷，將每個測點換到相同高程基準。確認負孔壓感測能力與飽和狀態，讓有效應力推論有可追溯的原始資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over effective stress increment, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Synchronize soil pressure, surface loading and settlement on a common elevation datum. Check sensor saturation and negative-pressure capability so the effective-stress inference rests on traceable observations.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把泵浦端負壓直接當深層孔壓，會高估深層改良；表面沉陷可能來自上層，尚未壓密的深層土在完工載重後仍會持續沉陷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Substituting pump suction for deep pore pressure overstates treatment at depth. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步量測土中孔壓、地表荷載及沉陷，將每個測點換到相同高程基準。確認負孔壓感測能力與飽和狀態，讓有效應力推論有可追溯的原始資料。同時排除以下干擾原因：若把泵浦端負壓直接當深層孔壓，會高估深層改良；表面沉陷可能來自上層，尚未壓密的深層土在完工載重後仍會持續沉陷。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronize soil pressure, surface loading and settlement on a common elevation datum. Check sensor saturation and negative-pressure capability so the effective-stress inference rests on traceable observations. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Substituting pump suction for deep pore pressure overstates treatment at depth. Surface settlement may occur mainly in upper layers while untreated deeper soil continues settling under the completed structure.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接有效應力增量時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。同步量測土中孔壓、地表荷載及沉陷，將每個測點換到相同高程基準。確認負孔壓感測能力與飽和狀態，讓有效應力推論有可追溯的原始資料。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over effective stress increment, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Synchronize soil pressure, surface loading and settlement on a common elevation datum. Check sensor saturation and negative-pressure capability so the effective-stress inference rests on traceable observations.

quiz.question: 要驗證「有效應力增量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Effective stress increment"?
options: 同步量測土中孔壓、地表荷載及沉陷，將每個測點換到相同高程基準。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要真空中斷恢復符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Synchronize soil pressure, surface loading and settlement on a common elevation datum.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A nominal result for pressure recovery after interruption removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 同步量測土中孔壓、地表荷載及沉陷，將每個測點換到相同高程基準。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize soil pressure, surface loading and settlement on a common elevation datum. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 有效應力增量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Effective stress increment: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「有效應力增量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Effective stress increment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把泵浦端負壓直接當深層孔壓，會高估深層改良；表面沉陷可能來自上層，尚未壓密的深層土在完工載重後仍會持續沉陷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Substituting pump suction for deep pore pressure overstates treatment at depth. Surface settlement may occur mainly in upper layers while untreated deeper soil continues settling under the completed structure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若把泵浦端負壓直接當深層孔壓，會高估深層改良；表面沉陷可能來自上層，尚未壓密的深層土在完工載重後仍會持續沉陷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Surface settlement may occur mainly in upper layers while untreated deeper soil continues settling under the completed structure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要有效應力增量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for effective stress increment removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把泵浦端負壓直接當深層孔壓，會高估深層改良；表面沉陷可能來自上層，尚未壓密的深層土在完工載重後仍會持續沉陷。
knowledge.textEn: Substituting pump suction for deep pore pressure overstates treatment at depth. Surface settlement may occur mainly in upper layers while untreated deeper soil continues settling under the completed structure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「有效應力增量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.instruction: 排水板阻力、邊界漏氣與透水夾層會降低深部可獲得的真空效果。傳遞比值是一項診斷量，不是固定材料常數，也不能直接當平均壓密度。假設泵端負壓幅值75kPa、深部45kPa，幅值傳遞比45/75=0.60；比較須同時刻且同一基準。在同一圖上混合不同時間的最大負壓可製造虛假的均勻性；若透水夾層不斷補水，深部可能長期維持較低有效應力而不易從泵表發現。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「深度負壓傳遞」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Combining maxima from different times creates false uniformity. A permeable lens can continuously recharge deep soil and maintain low effective stress without an obvious change on the pump gauge. steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Suction transfer with depth” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設泵端負壓幅值75kPa、深部45kPa，幅值傳遞比45/75=0.60；比較須同時刻且同一基準。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With pump suction magnitude75kPa and deep magnitude45kPa, the transfer ratio is45/75=0.60. Compare simultaneous observations on the same reference basis. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿排水板不同深度配置測點，將啟動後的時間反應與分區比較。

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 沿排水板不同深度配置測點，將啟動後的時間反應與分區比較。若深部幅值偏低，先查連通、滲漏與感測器，而不是直接增加上部堆載補償。同時排除以下干擾原因：在同一圖上混合不同時間的最大負壓可製造虛假的均勻性；若透水夾層不斷補水，深部可能長期維持較低有效應力而不易從泵表發現。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
